findings.current: My relaxed muscles loosened, and the flames coiling around my spearhead flickered.
findings.defect: The description repeats the same physical action.
findings.rationale: Removes the awkward repetition without changing the action.
findings.replacement: My muscles relaxed, and the flames coiling around my spearhead flickered.

findings.current: The Skeleton King held the [Hero’s Sword], shining with a brilliant light reserved for the chosen, and stared at him.
findings.defect: Square brackets around the item name conflict with the packet’s English-formatting rule.
findings.rationale: Retains the established item name while removing UI-style brackets from prose.
findings.replacement: The Skeleton King held the Hero’s Sword, shining with a brilliant light reserved for the chosen, and stared at him.
findings.source: Chapter 822, Skeleton King confronting Hamid Shah Masoud

findings.current: His physical wounds and fatigue had recovered, but his Middle Dantian was beyond the System’s power to heal.
findings.defect: The categorical claim that his wounds recovered contradicts the panel’s partial healing and the Broken Body debuff rejecting healing.
findings.rationale: Keeps the narration consistent with the immediately preceding System notices and Jin’s continuing condition.
findings.replacement: The Level Up had eased his wounds and fatigue, but it could not heal his Broken Body debuff, depleted mental strength, or overtaxed Middle Dantian.
findings.source: Chapter 823, narration immediately after the Level Up panel

findings.current: He was ashamed of himself for having no choice but to make it.
findings.defect: “Make it” has no clear antecedent, obscuring the decision Magic Johnson dreads.
findings.rationale: Makes the reference intelligible without stating the decision before he reaches it.
findings.replacement: He was ashamed of the decision he knew he had to make.
findings.source: Chapter 823, Magic Johnson considering Jin’s request

summary: The packet is largely consistent in voice and continuity. Four English-copy issues are actionable.
